title: Splitnir the Bleeding

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Splitnir the Bleeding is the upgraded form of Splitnir using the Bloodstone. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Bloodstone, their hit effect is damage increased by 0.2% for every point of health the player is missing (not the percentage missing).
Upgrading a Splitnir to Splitnir the Bleeding will always result in a quality 1 weapon, regardless of the original weapon's quality.
